text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo takes on the Kikuka Sho. Tokai 
Teio won't be there, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo won't let it faze her. She 
declares that she'll just run all 3,000 
meters in her own way, at full throttle.
